text: Most utility poles in Mexico are made of concrete and have an **octagonal shape**. There will often be engravings on the side.
NOTE: Octagonal poles are also common in Colombia.
text_zh: 墨西哥的大多數電線桿都是混凝土製成的，且具有**八角形形狀**。側邊通常會有雕刻。
注意：八角形電線桿在哥倫比亞也很常見。

text: Mexico uses short licence plates with a large variety of designs. Front plates are required.
NOTE: For an overview of the most common regional designs, see step 2.
text_zh: 墨西哥使用短車牌，有著多種不同的設計。強制規定要有前車牌。
注意：若要概覽最常見的地區設計，請參見步驟 2。

text: The most typical Mexican road lines are white solid outer lines with a **single unbroken yellow middle line**.
NOTE: [Single](https://goo.gl/maps/Dbjb5sJ1xcrQBTof7) broken yellow middle lines and [double](https://goo.gl/maps/L9YSqFc6h79idwkm8) yellow middle lines are also common.
text_zh: 墨西哥最典型的道路標線是白色的實線外線，配上一條**單一未斷的黃色中線**。
注意：[單一](https://goo.gl/maps/Dbjb5sJ1xcrQBTof7)斷續黃色中線和[雙](https://goo.gl/maps/L9YSqFc6h79idwkm8)黃色中線也很常見。

text: These small, **cylindrical** white bollards with a **black base** are unique to Mexico. A yellow reflector can sometimes be seen, as well as a flat version.
text_zh: 這些小型、**圓柱形**的白色路樁，底部為**黑色**，是墨西哥獨有的。有時可以看到黃色反光片，也有扁平的版本。

text: Mexico has two general road shields; one for national highways with “MEXICO” written at the top and a slightly curvy design, and one for state roads which have straight borders, and typically has the state initials written at the top.
text_zh: 墨西哥有兩種通用的道路盾形標誌；一種是頂部寫著「MEXICO」且設計略為彎曲的國道標誌，另一種是邊框筆直、通常頂部寫著州縮寫的州道標誌。

text: Mexican directional signs have a distinctly large, **all-caps** white font.
text_zh: 墨西哥的指示標誌具有明顯大型、**全大寫**的白色字體。

text: Mexican **kilometre markers** are white, with black font and outline.
text_zh: 墨西哥的**公里牌**是白色的，配有黑色字體和外框。

text: **Cacti**, of many different species, are extremely common in Mexico.
text_zh: 各種不同種類的**仙人掌**在墨西哥極為常見。

text: Mexico uses the word “ALTO” on stop signs.
NOTE: All of South America, as well as Puerto Rico, use the word “PARE”. Panama, Costa Rica, and Guatemala also use “ALTO”.
text_zh: 墨西哥在停止標誌上使用「ALTO」這個詞。
注意：整個南美洲以及波多黎各都使用「PARE」這個詞。巴拿馬、哥斯大黎加和瓜地馬拉也使用「ALTO」。

text: Arrows on signs are noticeably **very thick**.
text_zh: 標誌上的箭頭明顯**非常粗**。

text: **Yellow **accents on kerbs and bridge barriers are quite common.
text_zh: 路緣和橋樑護欄上的**黃色**點綴相當常見。

text: You will commonly see wide cylindrical, **black or white water tanks** on rooftops.
text_zh: 你經常會在屋頂上看到寬大的圓柱形**黑色或白色水塔**。

text: **OXXO** and **Pemex** are two of the most popular gas station brands in Mexico.

NOTE: While less common, OXXO can still be found in [other countries](https://www.google.com/maps/@-33.4481518,-70.5764202,3a,15y,199.57h,89.44t,1.18r/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sJaAVdAE4oby9-yp1rsx3PQ!2e0!5s20230501T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu).
text_zh: **OXXO** 和 **Pemex** 是墨西哥最熱門的兩大加油站品牌。
注意：雖然較少見，但在[其他國家](https://www.google.com/maps/@-33.4481518,-70.5764202,3a,15y,199.57h,89.44t,1.18r/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sJaAVdAE4oby9-yp1rsx3PQ!2e0!5s20230501T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)也能找到 OXXO。

text: Many place names in Mexico are of [Nahuatl](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nahuatl) origin, featuring a lot of ‘x’ and ‘tl’ as well as ‘-ec’ and ‘-tlan’ suffixes.
text_zh: 墨西哥的許多地名源自[納瓦特爾語](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nahuatl)，包含大量的「x」和「tl」，以及「-ec」和「-tlan」字尾。

text: Mexico uses **circular** electricity counters.
NOTE: Circular electricity counters are not unique to Mexico and can also be found in the US, Guatemala, Dominican Republic and the Philippines.
text_zh: 墨西哥使用**圓形**的電力計算器。
注意：圓形電力計算器並非墨西哥獨有，在美國、瓜地馬拉、多明尼加共和國和菲律賓也能找到。

text: United States car brands are popular in Mexico. In particular, you will see a lot of **pickup trucks**.
text_zh: 美國車牌在墨西哥很受歡迎。特別是，你會看到很多**皮卡車**。

text: Mexico is one of very few Latin American countries that has **Generation 2 coverage**.
NOTE: Brazil has some Generation 2, but it is considerably more rare, as most of it is overwritten.
text_zh: 墨西哥是極少數擁有**相機世代 2 街景覆蓋**的拉丁美洲國家之一。
注意：巴西也有一些相機世代 2 街景，但相當罕見，因為大部分都被覆蓋更新了。

text: The Generation 3 coverage in Mexico mainly feature two cars:
- A white car with a **stubby antenna**. There is a diagonal coil wrapped around the antenna.
- A white car with a more **visible **back and a long red **brake light** instead of an antenna.
It is possible to find a white car without a stubby antenna, but with a tiny [sliver](https://goo.gl/maps/qxynyEHgmp85RBmu5) visible where the antenna should be.
text_zh: 墨西哥的相機世代 3 街景主要有兩種車款：
- 一台白色車子，帶有**粗短的天線**。天線周圍纏繞著對角線的線圈。
- 一台白色車子，車尾**更明顯**，且有一個長型紅色**煞車燈**而不是天線。
你有時會找到一台沒有粗短的天線、但在原本該有天線的地方有一個微小[細長條](https://goo.gl/maps/qxynyEHgmp85RBmu5)可見的白色車子。

text: The Generation 4 cars in Mexico commonly have a visible front and can feature various different colour patterns. The three most common ones are:
- Blue
- White with a blue stripe
- Black
text_zh: 墨西哥的相機世代 4 車輛通常有明顯的車頭，並且可能具有各種不同的顏色圖案。最常見的三種是：
- 藍色
- 白色帶藍色條紋
- 黑色

text: The first digit of Mexican **area codes** are regional and can be seen on this map.
text_zh: 墨西哥**區碼**的第一位數是地區性的，可以從這張地圖上看到。

text: Similarly, Mexican **postal codes** can be seen on this map. They will commonly appear at the [bottom of street signs](https://goo.gl/maps/8bgZx7q8pjzzFSYi6), and are ordered alphabetically based on state names.
text_zh: 同樣地，墨西哥的**郵遞區號**也可以從這張地圖上看到。它們通常會出現在[路牌底部](https://goo.gl/maps/8bgZx7q8pjzzFSYi6)，並根據州名按字母順序排列。

text: Every state in Mexico has one or several unique licence plate designs. In this infographic you can find the most common and helpful ones.
text_zh: 墨西哥每個州都有一個或多個獨特的車牌設計。在這張資訊圖表中，你可以找到最常見和最有用的車牌。

text: **Prickly pear cacti** are distinct with their **flat oval-shaped pads**. They are noticeably more common centrally and are rarely seen in southern and coastal states.
text_zh: **梨果仙人掌**的特徵是它們**扁平的橢圓形莖節**。它們在中部地區明顯更常見，在南部和沿海各州則很少見。

text: Agave salmiana, also known as **pulque agaves**, have wide, smooth, curling leaves, and a **crown-like** appearance. They are common in the central Mexican valley and further north around the city of San Luis Potosi.
text_zh: 薩爾米亞龍舌蘭（Agave salmiana），也被稱為**普爾克龍舌蘭**，具有寬闊、平滑、捲曲的葉子，以及**皇冠般**的外觀。它們常見於墨西哥中部山谷以及更北邊的聖路易波托西市周邊。

text: Vast fields of **blue agave** (Agave tequilana), used to produce tequila, are mostly found in Jalisco and Nayarit.
text_zh: 用於生產龍舌蘭酒的大片**藍色龍舌蘭**（Agave tequilana）田，主要分佈在哈利斯科州和納亞里特州。

text: Yucca filifera, also known as **tree yucca**, as well as yucca decipiens are most commonly seen in San Luis Potosi and Zacatecas as well as some of the bordering northern states. They can be recognised by their oblong rosettes of sharp green leaves branching from a single trunk, similar to a tree.
text_zh: 絲蘭（Yucca filifera，也被稱為**樹絲蘭**）以及德西皮恩絲蘭最常見於聖路易波托西州和薩卡特卡斯州，以及一些北部邊境州。它們可以透過從單一主幹分枝、類似樹木的尖銳綠葉長橢圓形蓮座叢來辨認。

text: The **Mexican Giant Cardon** is an extremely common cacti in the Baja California peninsula. It can be identified through its large sprawling arms stemming from a singular trunk and ribbed exterior.
text_zh: **墨西哥巨柱仙人掌**是下加利福尼亞半島上極其常見的仙人掌。它可以透過從單一主幹長出的大型蔓延手臂和帶肋的外表來識別。

text: The **Saguaro** **Cacti** can be spotted in the western half of Sonora, featuring short curving arms that stem from a main trunk.
text_zh: **索諾拉巨柱仙人掌**可以在索諾拉州西部被發現，其特點是從主幹長出短短彎曲的手臂。

text: **Organ Pipe Cacti** have long thin stems that often come out from a stem that is around ground level. They are most commonly found in Sonora and occasionally in Baja California Sur.
text_zh: **管柱仙人掌**擁有長而細的莖，通常從地面附近的莖長出。它們最常見於索諾拉州，偶爾也在南下加利福尼亞州被發現。

text: The **Blue Myrtle Cacti** have short arms that uniformly curve and point upwards. It is abundantly found in San Luis Potosi, but also common in Queretaro and Hidalgo.
text_zh: **藍葉柱仙人掌**擁有短手臂，呈一致的曲線向上指。它大量分佈在聖路易波托西州，在克雷塔羅州和伊達爾戈州也很常見。

text: **Sugar cane** can be found all over the country, but by far most common in Veracruz.
text_zh: **甘蔗**全國各地都能找到，但以韋拉克魯斯州最為常見。

text: **Coconut palms **can be found all across the coast, but are often found in large groups in Guerrero and Colima.
text_zh: **椰子樹**全海岸都能找到，但通常在格 Guerrero 和科利馬州以大群落形式出現。

text: **Sabal palms **are most commonly observed in the east coast of Mexico, the Yucatan peninsula, as well as the state of Nayarit. They feature a spiky, sun-shaped crown, giving the tree a** lollipop-like **appearance.
text_zh: **沼生棕櫚**最常在墨西哥東海岸、猶加敦半島以及納亞里特州被觀察到。它們具有帶刺、太陽形狀的樹冠，賦予樹木**棒棒糖般**的外觀。

text: The **Attalea rostrata **is a huge palm recognizable from its upright leaves, almost resembling an umbrella. It is mostly exclusive to Veracruz and Tabasco, and can be rarely found in Chiapas.
text_zh: **美洲王棕**是一種巨大的棕櫚樹，以其直立的葉子而聞名，幾乎像是一把雨傘。它主要分布在韋拉克魯斯和塔巴斯科，在恰帕斯則較少見。

text: **Oil palm plantations **are most common in Chiapas, and occasionally on the outskirts of the state in Veracruz, Tabasco, and Campeche.
text_zh: **油棕園**最常見於恰帕斯州，偶爾也出現在該州周邊的韋拉克魯斯州、塔巴斯科州和坎佩切州。

text: **Boojum trees** can be recognized by their alien, **tentacle**-like appearance. They are almost exclusively found in the southern half of Baja California.
text_zh: **象鼻樹**可以透過其異形、**觸手**般的外觀來辨認。它們幾乎只分佈在下加利福尼亞州南部。

text: **Brittlebush** are small shrubs with bright **silver-grey** leaves that are most commonly found in Sonora, especially around Hermosillo.
text_zh: **刺葉灌木**是小型灌木，帶有明亮的**銀灰色**葉子，最常見於索諾拉州，特別是在埃莫西索周圍。

text: These **thin, white-barked **trees can be found in the Yucatan peninsula, but are most prevalent in Quintana Roo.
text_zh: 這些**白色薄皮的**樹木可以在猶加敦半島找到，但在金塔納羅奧州最為普遍。

text: These **gold tufts** of grass in a line right next to the road are most commonly found in Coahuila.
text_zh: 這些道路旁邊成排的**金色草叢**最常見於科阿韋拉州。

text: These **clumps **of grass in almost a teardrop shape are common in the region around Tlaxcala.
text_zh: 這些幾乎呈淚滴形狀的**草叢**在特拉斯卡拉周邊地區很常見。

text: **Red agricultural fields** are commonly seen in Zacatecas and occasionally southern Durango.
text_zh: **紅色農田**常見於薩卡特卡斯州，偶爾也見於杜蘭戈州南部。

text: The Monterrey metropolitan area features tall stunning **mountain ranges** that surround the city.
text_zh: 蒙特雷都會區擁有環繞城市的壯麗高大**山脈**。

text: The western parts of Chihuahua and Durango can feature a rocky mountainous landscape covered with **pine forests**. In general, these pines are shorter and more **stunted **in appearance than pine forests of the central or south.
text_zh: 奇ihuahua州和杜蘭戈州的西部地區可能具有覆蓋著**松林**的岩石山地景觀。一般來說，與中部或南部的松林相比，這些松樹外觀更矮、更**發育不良**。

text: **Extremely dark fields** are common in Guanajuato.
text_zh: **極黑的農田**在瓜納華托州很常見。

text: These **reddish brown-tinged** hills, often accompanied by **large boulders**, are a common sight for the northern half of Baja California.
text_zh: 這些**帶有紅褐色調**的丘陵，通常伴隨著**大巨石**，是下加利福尼亞州北部常見的景象。

text: Almost **blindingly white** soil in the Yucatan peninsula is most common in Quintana Roo.
NOTE: This is only consistent in Generation 3.
text_zh: 猶加敦半島幾乎**耀眼的白色**土壤在金塔納羅奧州最常見。
注意：這僅在相機世代 3 中一致。

text: These **red agricultural fields** surrounded by dense forests of tropical trees are most common in northern Campeche.
text_zh: 這些被熱帶樹木茂密森林包圍的**紅色農田**最常見於坎佩切州北部。

text: **Red brick** buildings are mostly concentrated in the states west of Mexico City, specifically Jalisco, Michoacan, Guanajuato, and Aguascalientes.
text_zh: **紅磚**建築主要集中在墨西哥城以西的州，特別是哈利斯科州、米卻肯州、瓜納華托州和阿瓜斯卡連特斯州。

text: **White concrete block **buildings are highly concentrated in the states surrounding Mexico city, and are generally more common to the east. They can however still be found all over the country.
text_zh: **白色混凝土磚**建築高度集中在墨西哥城周圍的州，且通常在東部更常見。不過，它們在全國各地仍然可以找到。

text: **Mud brick** buildings are most abundant in Durango, especially full houses constructed with mud brick. However, they can essentially be found in almost all of the dry desert states.
text_zh: **土磚**建築在杜蘭戈州最為豐富，特別是用土磚建造的完整房屋。然而，它們基本上可以在幾乎所有乾燥的沙漠州找到。

text: Architecture in northern Mexico often features design elements from American style bungalows. Many houses are coloured with **light **or **pastel **colours, **gated **and commonly have front yards. **Orange tiles** inspired by Spanish colonial architecture are also typical.
text_zh: 墨西哥北部的建築通常具有美式平房風格的設計元素。許多房屋漆成**淺色**或**粉彩色**，有**圍欄**且通常有前院。受西班牙殖民建築啟發的**橘色瓦片**也很典型。

text: **Thatched roofs** are most common in the Yucatan peninsula and eastern San Luis Potosi. They can also be found elsewhere, mainly in the southeast.
text_zh: **茅草屋頂**最常見於猶加敦半島和聖路易波托西州東部。它們也能在其他地方找到，主要在東南部。

text: These walls made of **light coloured rock** are found in the Yucatan peninsula, but most common in Yucatan state.
text_zh: 這些由**淺色岩石**製成的牆壁分佈在猶加敦半島，但在猶加敦州最為常見。

text: A thick **cross** can be seen on the back of signs in Chihuahua.
text_zh: 在奇ihuahua州的路牌背面可以看到一個粗大的**十字**。

text: Bollards with a **red band** near the top are unique to Nayarit, apart from [one exception](https://www.google.com/maps/@16.416407,-94.109672,3a,15y,95.28h,64.73t,0.03r/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1s_lRtg1MKWPSNX_dJch3kig!2e0!5s20220501T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) being Federal Highway 190 on the Oaxaca-Chiapas border.
text_zh: 頂部附近帶有**紅色條紋**的路樁是納亞里特州的獨有特徵，[除了一個例外](https://www.google.com/maps/@16.416407,-94.109672,3a,15y,95.28h,64.73t,0.03r/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1s_lRtg1MKWPSNX_dJch3kig!2e0!5s20220501T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)即瓦哈卡-恰帕斯邊境上的 190 號聯邦公路。

text: Jalisco bollards will sometimes have a **crown** and the text ‘**Jalisco**’ written on it. These are usually barely legible unless very close, however no other Mexican bollard will have writing on it.
text_zh: 哈利斯科州的路樁有時會刻有**皇冠**以及「**Jalisco**」字樣。這些字樣通常除非靠得非常近否則幾乎難以辨認，但沒有其他墨西哥路樁會有文字。

text: **White insulators** that are shaped like acorns can be found along the coastal states of Mexico, but are by far most common in Michoacan, Colima, and Veracruz.
text_zh: 形狀像橡實的**白色絕緣子**可以在墨西哥的沿海各州找到，但以米却肯州（Michoacan）、科利馬州（Colima）和韋拉克魯斯州（Veracruz）最為常見。

text: Poles with an **asymmetric crossbar **and **double-stacked **insulators are exclusive to Mexico City, State of Mexico, Hidalgo, and Morelos.
text_zh: 具有**不對稱橫樑**和**雙層疊加**絕緣子的電線桿是墨西哥市、墨西哥州、伊達爾戈州和莫雷洛斯州所獨有的。

text: **Wooden **poles with a **lowered crossbar** are mostly found in Sinaloa and Sonora.
text_zh: 帶有**降低橫樑**的**木製**電線桿大多見於錫納羅亞州（Sinaloa）和索諾拉州（Sonora）。

text: These concrete poles with insulators **suspended below **the crossbars are unique to the Yucatan peninsula.
text_zh: 這些絕緣子**懸掛在橫樑下方**的混凝土電線桿是尤加塔半島（Yucatan peninsula）特有的。

text: The **wooden **variant of the hanging pole is found on the Baja California peninsula.
text_zh: 這種懸掛式電線桿的**木製**變體可以在下加利福尼亞半島（Baja California peninsula）找到。

text: Poles with a lowered crossbar and a **single support beam** that extend from one end of the crossbar to the pole itself can be found in Durango.
text_zh: 帶有降低橫樑且有單一**支撐樑**從橫樑一端延伸至電線桿本身的電線桿可以在杜蘭戈州（Durango）找到。

text: Poles with a** mesh body** are most commonly found in San Luis Potosi, Guanajuato, and Queretaro.
text_zh: 具有**網狀桿身**的電線桿最常出現在聖路易波托西州（San Luis Potosi）、瓜納華托州（Guanajuato）和克雷塔羅州（Queretaro）。

text: **White **middle roadlines are most commonly found in Tabasco.
text_zh: **白色**中間道路標線最常出現在塔巴斯科州（Tabasco）。

text: These fences made out of trees with **red-coloured bark **are commonly found in Veracruz.
NOTE: These tree fences can still be found in other coastal states and are best utilised when combined with other clues.
text_zh: 這些由帶有**紅色樹皮**的樹木所組成的籬笆常見於韋拉克魯斯州（Veracruz）。
注意：這些樹籬仍然可以在其他沿海各州找到，最好與其他線索結合使用。

text: **Black tar** on both sides of the yellow centre line can be seen in Sinaloa, Durango, and Guerrero.
NOTE: This is most reliable when the tar is not faded.
text_zh: 黃色中心線兩側都有**黑色柏油**的情況可以在錫納羅亞州（Sinaloa）、杜蘭戈州（Durango）和格雷羅州（Guerrero）看到。
注意：當柏油沒有褪色時，這個線索最為可靠。

text: **Grainy **pavement with a** blue-ish grey tinge** is a common sight for the states of Tamaulipas and Nuevo Leon.
NOTE: In Tamaulipas, larger roads very commonly feature [dashed outer lines](https://goo.gl/maps/J82S2uF1oZ7qGhEG6).
text_zh: 帶有**藍灰色調**的**顆粒狀**路面是塔毛利帕斯州（Tamaulipas）和新萊昂州（Nuevo Leon）常見的景象。
注意：在塔毛利帕斯州，較大的道路非常常出現[虛線外側標線](https://goo.gl/maps/J82S2uF1oZ7qGhEG6)。

text: This style of **cobblestone pavement**, unorganised with irregular tiles, can be found in most of the central states, but is by far most commonly found in the states of Nayarit, Jalisco, Colima, and Queretaro.
text_zh: 這種風格的**卵石路面**雜亂無章且磁磚不規則，可以在大多數中部各州找到，但以納亞里特州（Nayarit）、哈利斯科州（Jalisco）、科利馬州（Colima）和克雷塔羅州（Queretaro）最為常見。

text: This pavement consisting of **hexagonal tiles** is found in Puebla and Tlaxcala.
text_zh: 這種由**六角形磁磚**組成的路面可以在普 Puebla（普埃布拉州）和特拉斯卡拉州（Tlaxcala）找到。

text: This exact pavement design with **three lines** of cobblestone patterning is mainly found in Oaxaca.
text_zh: 這種具有**三條**卵石圖案線條的精確路面設計主要在瓦哈卡州（Oaxaca）找到。

text: Taxis in and around Mexico City have a white lower half with a **pink upper half**.
text_zh: 墨西哥市及周邊的出租車下半部為白色，**上半部為粉紅色**。

text: The area around **Mexicali** features flat farmland with a ridge to the west. [Washingtonia](https://goo.gl/maps/Z9JhouH2WnYeJW1z8)[ palms](https://goo.gl/maps/Z9JhouH2WnYeJW1z8) are very common and these [poles](https://goo.gl/maps/JG3LABTi1T4aSrzc9) made out of brown wood can be found.
text_zh: **墨西加利**（Mexicali）周邊地區的地形為平坦的農田，西側有一道山脊。[華盛頓棕櫚](https://goo.gl/maps/Z9JhouH2WnYeJW1z8)[樹](https://goo.gl/maps/Z9JhouH2WnYeJW1z8)非常普遍，並且可以找到這些由棕色木頭製成的[電線桿](https://goo.gl/maps/JG3LABTi1T4aSrzc9)。

text: The area around Poza Rica in Veracruz features a lot of **citrus tree plantations**. It is common to see large amounts of these trees grown right on top of the hills.
text_zh: 韋拉克魯斯州（Veracruz）的波薩里卡（Poza Rica）周邊地區有許多**柑橘類樹木種植園**。常見到大量這些樹木直接生長在山丘頂部。

text: The area around Ciudad Obregon is distinct due to the **pinkish-tan soil **and **canals **found around the city’s agricultural areas.
text_zh: 奧夫雷岡城（Ciudad Obregon）周邊地區的特色在於該市農業區周圍的**粉紅色帶黃褐色土壤**和**運河**。

text: The **twin volcanoes** of Iztaccíhuatl and Popocatépetl are found on the border between the State of Mexico and Puebla. Keep in mind that they are [usually much less visible](https://goo.gl/maps/3zngjfu2ucdDwvcV6) than depicted in the image, which is just for reference.
text_zh: 伊斯塔西瓦特爾火山（Iztaccíhuatl）與波波卡特佩特火山（Popocatépetl）這座**雙子火山**位於墨西哥州和普埃布拉州的邊界上。請記住，它們[通常比圖片中所描繪的還要不明顯](https://goo.gl/maps/3zngjfu2ucdDwvcV6)，圖片僅供參考。

text: **Cerro del Bernal **is a distinct extinct volcano that is found in southern Tamaulipas. It can be found heading directly northwest of Tampico or west of Morón.
text_zh: 貝爾納爾山（Cerro del Bernal）是一座位於塔毛利帕斯州（Tamaulipas）南部的獨特死火山。朝坦皮科（Tampico）正西北方或莫龍（Morón）西方即可找到。

text: This extremely **long **and **flat ridge** is found in the Sierra del Abra Tanchipa Biosphere Reserve in eastern San Luis Potosi.
text_zh: 這個極為**長**且**平坦的山脊**位於聖路易波托西州東部的阿布拉坦奇帕山生物圈保護區（Sierra del Abra Tanchipa Biosphere Reserve）內。

text: This tall, flat ridge, with very **prominent ridgelines**, belongs to the Maderas del Carmen Biosphere Reserve in Northern Coahuila near the US border.
NOTE: The only road the mountain range can be observed from is the Federal Highway 53 that leads to Boquillas del Carmen.
text_zh: 這座高而平坦的山脊擁有非常 **顯眼的山脊線**，屬於位於美國邊境附近科阿韋拉州北部的馬德拉斯德爾卡門生物圈保護區。
注意：唯一能觀賞到這個山脈的道路是通往博基拉斯德爾卡門的 53 號聯邦公路。

text: The outskirts of Ciudad Juárez features a lot of dirt roads with a distinct shade of **orange soil **and **low shrubs**.
text_zh: 華雷斯城的市郊有許多土路，帶有明顯的 **橘色土壤** 色調和 **低矮灌木**。

text: The area around San Cristóbal Suchixtlahuaca and south of it in Oaxaca often feature rolling hills with really distinct **orange **and **beige**-tinged soil, passing from one colour to the other with each hill. The beige-tinged soil can be seen more [prominent](https://goo.gl/maps/HzfgXbCXgYegsKodA) in some locations.
text_zh: 聖克里斯托瓦爾-蘇奇斯特拉瓦卡（San Cristóbal Suchixtlahuaca）周邊及瓦哈卡州南部的地區，經常有起伏的山丘，帶有非常明顯的 **橘色** 和 **米色** 調土壤，每座山丘都在這兩種顏色之間轉換。在某些地點，米色調的土壤會更 [顯眼](https://goo.gl/maps/HzfgXbCXgYegsKodA)。

text: The town of Guaymas has a lot of **jagged **cliffs and mountains that make the area very distinct. The soil is also distinctly pinkish and organ-pipe cacti can be seen scattered on the hills and next to the road.
text_zh: 瓜伊馬斯鎮有許多 **陡峭的** 懸崖和山脈，使該地區非常獨特。土壤也明顯呈粉紅色，仙人柱散布在山丘上和道路旁。

text: The town of Las Coloradas is famously known for the **pink lakes** around the area.
text_zh: 拉斯科洛拉達斯鎮以該地區周圍的 **粉紅湖** 而聞名。

text: The 54 is a divided highway that runs through northeastern Zacatecas which features **yucca trees** spammed on both sides of the road. Additionally, the streetview car is often exposed and appears almost [white](https://goo.gl/maps/BfA6FLRVcL371P9z9) due to the sunlight.
text_zh: 54 號公路是一條貫穿薩卡特卡斯州東北部的分道公路，道路兩側長滿了 **絲蘭樹**。此外，街景車經常曝光過度，在陽光下看起來幾乎呈 [白色](https://goo.gl/maps/BfA6FLRVcL371P9z9)。

text: The 40D that crosses the Sinaloa-Durango state line is recognizable by the stunning lush **cliffs **and mountains along the road. The highway commonly passes through tunnels and the road itself features **double yellow** middle roadlines.
text_zh: 穿越錫那羅亞州與杜蘭戈州省界的 40D 公路，可以透過沿途令人驚嘆的茂密 **懸崖** 和山脈來辨識。這條公路經常穿過隧道，路面本身則有 **雙黃線** 的中央道路標線。

text: This road divider with a **yellow** **top **and **bottom **edge is found all along the 95D from Mexico City to Acapulco.
text_zh: 這種帶有 **黃色** **頂部** 和 **底部** 邊緣的道路分隔島，在從墨西哥城到阿卡普爾科的 95D 公路沿線都可以看到。

text: The Eurus Wind Farm is located in southeast Oaxaca and is the largest wind farm in Mexico. Rows of **wind turbines** can be found along the 190 around Juchitán de Zaragoza.
text_zh: 優魯斯風場位於瓦哈卡州東南部，是墨西哥最大的風場。沿著胡奇坦德薩拉戈薩周邊的 190 號公路可以找到一排排的 **風力發電機**。

text: Most lamp posts and lamp arms in Aguascalientes city are **yellow**.
NOTE: They are **not **exclusive and are only very common.
text_zh: 阿瓜斯卡連特斯市的大多數路燈柱和燈臂都是 **黃色** 的。
注意：它們 **並非** 專屬特徵，只是非常常見。

text: This lamp with a **black **rectangular head is found in Cuernavaca.
text_zh: 這種帶有 **黑色** 長方形燈頭的路燈可以在庫埃納瓦卡找到。

text: This lamp with black front and back **edges **and a white middle section is found in Santiago de Queretaro.
text_zh: 這種前後帶有黑色 **邊緣** 且中間為白色的路燈可以在聖地亞哥-德克雷塔羅找到。

text: This lamp with **five **circular bulbs that looks like a **dice **is found in Cancun.
text_zh: 這種帶有 **五個** 圓形燈泡、看起來像 **骰子** 的路燈可以在坎昆找到。

text: This lamp with a rectangular head and a **ring-shaped** light bulb is found in Matamoros.
text_zh: 這種帶有長方形燈頭和 **環形** 燈泡的路燈可以在馬塔莫羅斯找到。

text: This lamp with a** zig-zag **bent pole arm is found in Hermosillo.
text_zh: 這種燈桿手臂呈 **之字形** 彎曲的路燈可以在埃莫西約找到。

text: The bottom half of poles in Cuernavaca are often painted **green**.
NOTE: In Generation 4, the paint usually looks faded, some to the point where it is barely visible.
text_zh: 庫埃納瓦卡的燈桿下半部通常漆成 **綠色**。
NOTE: 在 Gen 4 中，漆面通常看起來會退色，有些甚至退到幾乎看不見。

text: Poles in Chihuahua city occasionally have a strip of **white pole paint** with the street name written in black or blue text.
text_zh: Chihuahua 市的電線桿偶爾會有一段**白色電線桿漆**，上面用黑色或藍色文字寫著街道名稱。

text: This Street View car with a **yellow hood** can be found by the La Malinche volcano in Tlaxcala.
text_zh: 這輛帶著**黃色引擎蓋**的 Google 車可以在 Tlaxcala 的 La Malinche 火山附近找到。

text: This **white truck** with visible rearview mirrors can be seen in the Cofre de Perote national park.
text_zh: 這輛看得見後照鏡的**白色卡車**可以在 Cofre de Perote 國家公園看到。

text: This **red **Street View car with a black roof can be found in the town of La Seca in Sinaloa.
text_zh: 這輛有著黑色車頂的**紅色 **Google 車可以在 Sinaloa 的 La Seca 鎮找到。
